image_description: A close-up view of a circular aneroid barometer with a gold-colored metal casing. The dial face is white with black numerical markings and text. The scale shows pressure readings in millibars (700-790 visible) and inches of mercury (28-31 range implied). The dial includes weather indicators: 'STORMY', 'RAIN', 'FAIR', 'VERY DRY'. There are two pointer hands - a black one and a gold one. The center of the dial has a cutout revealing the internal mechanical movement with gears and springs. A watermark 'stockphoto' is visible across the center.
